title: No durable catalog scope family for non-git connector sources
wanted_capability: A durable project-catalog scope identity for connector sources that have no git repository and no committed .bbox/config.toml (a Drive folder, a SharePoint library, a Slack workspace, a Xero tenant). PublishedScope mints repo_id from a committed config at local HEAD; connector sources need an equivalent durable, host-independent identity that producer grants can bind and the catalog can hold, with provider coordinates (folder ids, workspace ids) treated as attachment observations rather than identity. Candidate shapes analyzed in design/connectors/remote-source-connectors.md (ConnectorScope variant; grant-time synthetic connector_source_id; committed-config-in-cache, rejected).
missing_primitive: Connector scope family in the durable project catalog plus grant-time minting rules
notes: Phase 0 of the remote-source connector design blocks on this; every network connector profile (file-tree, conversation, API-dataset) inherits it.
resolution_note: Phase 0 shipped on beta/blackbox-v2 (662d7312, branch feat/connector-scope-phase0, cluster verify green): ProjectScope::Connector(ConnectorScope { connector_source_id, connector_kind }) with uniqueness and grant lookup keyed on connector_source_id alone; provider coordinates as snapshot-level observations; content-derived catalog versioning (v2 until a connector scope exists, then v3) with the downgrade proven at both layers (typed unsupported_version from the startup probe, strict-deser refusal on direct row decode); [source_connectors] producer grant family with fail-closed token validation and no credential retention; grant-validated find-or-create onboarding composite; pending-onboarding admission excluded from every publication lane; honest rendering on catalog list/get and publisher status. Gate met: onboards/lists/reports with no publication, tampered and non-granted scopes refused, downgrade proven. Phase 1 (satellite substrate + fixture connector + wire endpoint) is the first caller of the onboarding composite.
